  • Parking Park and walk straight in.

The Gallery

The Front Bar

Hand-burnt timber, a wall of old bottles and a barrel at every elbow.

The Parlour

The Aviary

A glass courtyard in the middle of the shop: plants, birdsong and a fountain.

The Raised Booth

A private chair on a tiled stage, rimmed in red light.
